focus: Run the existing body-parity checkers (check-agent-mirror-sync --all, every upstream_assets sync script --check, cross-tree hash comparison) and report real drift, then the Q11 canon comparison of three doctor commands and two sk-git references against the sk-doc templates.

label: The agent body-parity gate names only three runtimes (opencode required, claude required, codex optional) in RUNTIME_MIRRORS, so .pi/agents — 11 real files, code.md at 48863 B, byte-distinct from .skilled (49002) and .claude (48781) — has no body-parity check at commit time; .cursor and .devin escape the gap only because their files are symlinks into .claude/agents, while .dsh uses a fourth mechanism (*.patch.yml). check-agent-mirror-sync --all still reports '11 agent(s) checked — all mirrors in sync'.

Two scripts in the same pipeline name different canonical agent roots: check-agent-mirror-sync.cjs treats .opencode/agents (a symlink to .skilled/agents) as authored canonical, while sync-runtime-mirrors.cjs sets CLAUDE_AGENTS = '.claude/agents' and comments that Cursor and Devin deliberately source from there. Both pass today only because the trees agree modulo path rewriting; editing .claude/agents/x.md changes what Cursor and Devin execute via symlink but blocks the commit gate until .skilled/agents/x.md is hand-edited, and the reverse edit propagates to nobody.

agent-roster-mirror-check.cjs and command-catalog-mirror-check.cjs both reject --check and exit 2, although doctor-runtime-mirrors.yaml's mutation_boundaries invariant states every upstream_assets checker is invoked in its check-only form and lists both under upstream_assets. Repro run this iteration: `--check` exits 2 for both scripts, no-args exits 0; the other ten upstream assets accept --check.

The sentence 'Use only <tree>/agents/*.md as the canonical runtime path reference' appears in .skilled/agents/code.md:26, .claude/agents/code.md:11 and .pi/agents/code.md:19 with three different referents; the .pi copy is sharpest because a Pi agent is told the canonical reference is .skilled/agents while executing from .pi/agents/code.md (Nov 8 16:20), a tree no .pi runtime resolves. mirror-sync-verify.cjs:141 normalizes .skilled|opencode|claude|pi into one token before comparing, so this drift is invisible to the checker by construction.

/doctor:ci carries 'skill_agent: sk-code' while /doctor:git carries sk-git and /doctor:runtime-mirrors carries system-skilled-doctor, yet the CI canon lives at .skilled/skills/sk-git/references/continuous-integration.md — an agent routing on the tag loads the code-implementation skill to answer a GitHub Actions question owned by sk-git. Distinct from the tag's already-logged duplicated identity: here the tag's value names the wrong owner.

All three existing parity gates report clean at HEAD: check-agent-mirror-sync --all = '11 agent(s) checked — all mirrors in sync — OK' exit 0; sync-runtime-mirrors --check = 'PASS: 247 mirrors across 10 trees are in sync' exit 0; sync-agents --check = 'PASS: 11 agents are in sync' exit 0. The per-agent byte deltas (146-228 B, smallest orchestrate, largest prompt-improver) are frontmatter dialect (permission: block vs tools: line) plus 18 path-token lines, not body drift — so the gates are telling the truth about what they measure.

Symlink audit before any duplication claim: .opencode/agents -> ../.skilled/agents (symlink, hence one git entry for the whole tree); .cursor/agents/code.md -> ../../.claude/agents/code.md; .devin/agents/code/AGENT.md -> ../../../.claude/agents/code.md; .pi/agents/code.md is a regular 48863-byte file; .dsh/agents holds *.patch.yml overlay files. No tree duplicates another's body except by design.

direction: Doctor command routers and sk-git references deviate from the sk-doc command/reference templates in section vocabulary or ordering
reason: Verified conformant on both sides. command-router-template.md:33 names OWNED ASSETS and PRESENTATION BOUNDARY as the blocking core and :62 fixes the six-section skeleton; /doctor:ci carries exactly ROUTER CONTRACT, OWNED ASSETS, MODE ROUTING, EXECUTION TARGETS, PRESENTATION BOUNDARY, WORKFLOW SUMMARY (ci.md:12-82), uppercase and divider-separated, and /doctor:git adds MANDATORY INPUT GATE in the template's prescribed position while ci correctly omits it (the command contract keeps input.required true only for the skill-advisor, git and mcp routers). template-rules.json:326-329 requires an overview section and a trailing related section; worktree-workflows.md:23 and commit-workflows.md:443 satisfy both.
